role: exact continuous shared-target action coverage at the original library's zero-coverage reference states
registration_context: all original-library local action outcomes observed; continuous-family suffix outcomes unobserved

roster.reference_snapshots: the same current snapshots at window starts 0,60,...,1320 minutes; actual stocks and both pending nominations retained
roster.dependence: 23 overlapping histories at one common nomination event, not 23 independent events
roster.reuse: retain the 50 covered states and all 73 negative controls from the preceding diagnostic; do not rerun their LPs

action_family.target: one shared continuous fraction theta in [0,1], with each unit target theta times its original capacity
action_family.rule: unchanged V3 received-only planning terms, efficiency conversion, individual known power clipping and shared absolute-power normalization
action_family.raw_breakpoints: 0,1 and each in-range unit fraction where projected SOC equals target or the raw nomination reaches either known power bound; a unit with no new-slot idle time has identically zero nomination
action_family.power_breakpoints: on every sign-fixed clipped affine interval, add the in-range root of sum(abs(raw nominations))=98 MW
action_family.exact_representation: each resulting interval maps continuously onto the line segment between its endpoint nominations; under shared normalization the curve has an affine numerator and common positive affine denominator, so its image remains that full segment
action_family.inventory_rates: split at all nomination sign changes before converting endpoint powers to inventory rates; both power and rate then interpolate along the same segment
action_family.no_grid_search: enumerate analytic clipping, sign and normalization breakpoints; add no target grid, profiles, seed or heuristic

suffix_test.initial_state: actual two-unit stocks at each selected reference snapshot
suffix_test.locked_commitments: first two half-hours equal the original pending nominations
suffix_test.new_nomination: third half-hour inventory rates must lie on exactly one attainable action segment, enforced by one interpolation variable in [0,1]
suffix_test.continuation: all subsequent nominations free with full future BOA information through the original window end
suffix_test.physical_model: unchanged unit capacities, efficiency, gross site bound and BOA priority
suffix_test.evaluation: test every analytic segment, keeping infeasible and unresolved results
suffix_test.replay: independently replay every feasible witness; reconstruct its scalar theta from the segment interpolation, recompute nominate_units at that theta, and check the third nomination against the replayed witness
suffix_test.construction_check: endpoint and interval-interior rule evaluations must agree with the claimed attainable segment, and theta=0.50 must reconstruct the saved reference action

analysis: per snapshot, any replayed feasible segment establishes a finite-library sampling gap; all segments proved infeasible establish a gap in this fixed shared-target action family at that actual reference state; remaining solver or replay discrepancies stay unresolved
decision: if the continuous shared-target family fails, consider unit-specific target fractions or earlier causal planning; if it succeeds, address finite candidate coverage. Freeze the chosen controller revision only after this diagnostic. The full source-comparison gate stays HOLD
limitations: local counterfactual actions at dependent reference histories and perfect-information continuations; neither branch proves absence or existence of a shared causal policy, source benefit, whole-window performance or independent confirmation
